tool_description: PanDermCLS is an open-source ViT-based model fine-tuned on the HAM10000 dermoscopy dataset for 7-class skin-lesion classification (akiec, bcc, bkl, df, mel, nv, vasc). It performs single-image inference and outputs the predicted label with class probabilities.
demo_commands: docker run --rm --gpus all -v /home/yourpath/HAM10000:/data dermcls python infer.py --image_path /data/imagesTs/ISIC_0029068.jpg --output_txt /data/result.txt

image_path.description: Absolute path to a dermoscopic image (PNG/JPG).

output_txt.description: Destination path for the TXT result file.

results_txt.description: Path to the TXT file containing the predicted class and associated confidence scores.
